newsitem.title: USA: ComEd LaSalle, Ill. nuke startup postponed.
newsitem.headline: ComEd LaSalle, Ill. nuke startup postponed.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co (ComEd) has postponed the startup of its 1,078 megawatt LaSalle nuclear power unit 1 until near the end of the week after being shut for unexpected repairs last weekend, a company spokesman said.
"It should be back up later this week," spokesman Gary Wald said Wednesday.
ComEd had originally expected the Seneca, Ill., unit to resume operations Sept 25.

Although repairs have been completed to a turbine valve, the postponement was necessary while the company investigated the potential for trapped air and an uneven pressure flow in a residual heat removal system, Wald said.

The 1,078 megawatt LaSalle nuclear power unit 2, also located in Seneca, was shut down for an estimated 65 days for refueling and maintenance and expected to resume operations near the end of November.
